jobs.description: Do your Best Work in Mooresville This position is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. This role requires the ability to translate large and complex data sets into actionable business insights and clearly communicate those insights to both financial and non-financial partners. While prior experience with supplier negotiations, commodity markets, tariffs, and international trade is beneficial, these capabilities can be developed within the role. A strong foundation in retail merchandising, analytical problem solving, financial modeling, and cross-functional partnership is critical. Experience developing financial models used to support business or negotiation decisions. MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant advanced degree or certification.
